title: Aliens take people to build a critical mass

tellings.quote: I also ask them why they take some people like they took me and tomorrow they might take you and so on.

plain: Aliens take certain people, one after another, to build up a critical mass of humans who have had contact, according to a man who was president of one of Russia's republics and says he was taken himself in 1997. He tells Michels that he asked the beings directly "why they take some people like they took me and tomorrow they might take you," and the answer he describes is that the taking is building toward a large enough number of people.
